sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: Syzygium aromaticum, the clove tree, is an evergreen tropical tree about 8–20 m tall. Its opposite, glossy leaves are aromatic and reach about 13 cm long.

sections.title: Clove spice
sections.text: The spice is made from the unopened flower buds, about 1.5–2 cm long, picked when they turn red and then dried. Open flowers have numerous pale stamens; the mature fruit is a dark purple, oblong berry about 2–2.5 cm long.

sections.title: Related Syzygium
sections.text: Unlike water apple and the rose apples, this species is chiefly cultivated for its aromatic buds rather than for its fruit. The plate correctly shows flower clusters, a bud and the dried clove spice.
